corrected_content.problem:
Given the system of equations below, what is the value of $a - b$?

$$
\displaystyle \left\{\begin{aligned}3a + 2b &=4 \\ - 4a + b &=2\end{aligned}\right.
$$
corrected_content.worked_solution: The second equation gives $b=2+4a$. Substitute into the first equation: $3a+2(2+4a)=4$, so $11a=0$. Thus $a=0$, $b=2$, and $a-b=-2$.
